description: A bed with a dark blue blanket and a pale pink pillow is in view, with an open rectangular box standing upright and three small paperback books lying nearby. The right hand picks up the green book and slides it vertically down into the open box, then reaches to the right to lift the red book and inserts it beside the green one, and finally grabs the blue Tolkien book and pushes it into the box alongside the others before letting go.
